requirement: S04/S10 source publication preserves a complete old or new head and reports the committed outcome accurately.
gap_closed: Existing foreground interruption fixtures used fts_only even in native feature builds. They now use local native vectors in native builds and explicitly verify absent vector identity/data in no-vector builds.
production_change: None; strengthened existing two acceptance functions with actual native-store and complete-body checks.
wanted_behavior: Initial full repair produces exact known source body/range and physical revision, with native vector and lexical identity/coverage agreement.

Prepublication cancellation and refused CAS preserve complete original source and physical identity. A valid cancellation retry converges to complete replacement source; competing directory correction is preserved on rejected CAS.

After authoritative publication, cancellation or purge/settlement/graph/derived-edge finalization failure retains complete replacement source and reports its actual committed generation, degraded status and exact incomplete step.
Known fixture source bytes independently determine expected recovered body; selected lexical count and native physical selection prevent a mere marker hit from masquerading as complete source.
incidental_native_case: The first filter also selected foreground_and_background_registration_publish_their_own_complete_initial_generation, which passed. It is not counted as one of the two intended native-vector functions and was excluded from the no-vector run.
review: Local review checked original independent fixture text, complete physical source/vector comparison, existing public interruption controls, preserved exact outcome/identity assertions, and runtime-before-TempDir teardown. No external review pass claimed.
limits: Hooks remain before sealing and after authoritative CAS; complete body/vector results are checked after request settlement. This does not directly observe every individual store commit or inject every intermediate storage fault.
All-writer, abrupt-crash, partial-native-upsert and broader recovery fault coverage remain open.
No full S04/S10 or all19-gate closure, performance claim, or new installed MCP transport execution.

resources.closure: Request jobs settle and runtime teardown precedes explicit fixture close; both result inventories empty.
resources.retention: Logs, result/source-binding receipts and empty runner TEMP containers retained. No preexisting folders deleted.
